'''Fazila Ibrahim gizi Samadova''', also known as '''Fazila Samedova''' ({{langx|az|Fəzilə Səmədova}}; 29 March 1929, Shamakhi – 8 January 2020, Baku), was an Azerbaijani academician chemical engineer-technologist. She was a Doctor of Chemical Sciences, Honored Scientist, Member of [[New York Academy of Sciences]], Head of the Laboratory at the Research Institute of Petrochemical Processes, Corresponding Member of [[Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences]] (ANAS),<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last=Media.Az|title=Скончался известный азербайджанский ученый|url=https://media.az/society/1067760491/skonchalas-izvestnaya-azerbaydzhanskaya-uchenaya/|access-date=2020-12-05|website=media.az|language=ru}}</ref> Honorary Scientist of Europe.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Награда пришла из Германии|url=http://www.anl.az/down/meqale/kaspi/2012/fevral/235490.htm|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2020-12-05|website=www.anl.az}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Fazila Samadova was born on 29 March 1929 in [[Shamakhi]], Republic of Azerbaijan.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=NEFT KİMYA PROSESLƏRİ İNSTİTUTU|url=http://www.nkpi.az/?page=directorate&id=8|access-date=2020-12-05|website=www.nkpi.az}}</ref> In 1946, she graduated from Baku secondary school No. 132 with a gold medal.<ref name=":0" /> The same year, Samadova was admitted to the Faculty of Chemical Technology of the [[Azerbaijan Industrial Institute]] named after M. Azizbayov.<ref name=":1" />

After graduating from the institute in 1951, Samedova received a diploma in chemical engineering and continued her studies from 1951 to 1955 as a postgraduate student at the [[Gubkin Russian State University of Oil and Gas]].<ref name=":0" />

== Career ==
Samadova started her first scientific developments in the 1950s as a postgraduate student at the Gubkin Russian State University of Oil and Gas and at the [[Azerbaijan State Oil and Industry University|Azerbaijan Industrial Institute]], after which she continued them already at the Institute of Petroleum Industry.<ref name=":4">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=2006-12-19|title=ОНА СЛОВНО РОДИЛАСЬ ИССЛЕДОВАТЕЛЕМ – так говорит директор института нефтехимпроцессов|url=https://azertag.az/ru/xeber/ONA_SLOVNO_RODILAS_ISSLEDOVATELEM___tak_govorit_direktor_instituta_neftehimprocessov-656777|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2020-12-05|website=AЗЕРБАЙДЖАНСКОЕ ГОСУДАРСТВЕННОЕ ИНФОРМАЦИОННОЕ AГЕНТСТВО}}</ref> In 1956, she defended her dissertation on "The effect of the chemical composition of oils on their performance properties" and received the degree of Candidate of Technical Sciences.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Səmədova Fazilə İbrahim qızı|url=http://science.gov.az/forms/skanchavshiesya-chlenyikorrespondentyi/3743|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2020-12-05|website=science.gov.az}}</ref>

From 1960 to 1981, Samadova worked in the laboratory "Chemistry and Technology of Oils" of the Azerbaijan State Institute of Petrochemical Processes named after M. Aliyev as a senior researcher.<ref name=":0" /> The results of research conducted by Samadova in 1960-1973 were reflected in the dissertation of the scientist on "Research of obtaining distillate and residual oils from Baku paraffin oils with high cost-effective technologies and prospects for production in Azerbaijan" and she successfully defended her doctorate.<ref name=":2" />

From 1982, Samadova was in charge of the laboratory "Research of oils and technology of oils".<ref name=":0" /> From 1986, she headed the Petroleum Research and Oil Technology Laboratory of the NKPI.<ref name=":2" />
[[File:Şöhrət_ordeni-2009.jpg|thumb|229x229px|Şöhrət ordeni-2009]]
Samadova was awarded the title of Professor of Oil and Gas Technology (1987), the title of [[Honored Scientist of Azerbaijan]] (1991), and elected a full member of the New York Academy of Sciences.<ref name=":2" /> Since 2001, she has become a corresponding member of Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences (ANAS).<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=2013-05-10|title=Azərbaycan bugünkü uğurlarına görə ulu öndər Heydər Əliyevə borcludur|url=https://azertag.az/xeber/Azerbaycan_bugunku_ugurlarina_gore_ulu_onder_Heyder_Aliyeve_borcludur-212701|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2020-12-05|website=AZƏRBAYCAN DÖVLƏT İNFORMASİYA AGENTLİYİ}}</ref>

The results of Samadova's research work are reflected in 530 scientific works, including 24 monographs, 1 publicist book, 64 author's certificates and patents.<ref name=":2" /> One of her monographs is dedicated to the memory of her brother, explorer Fuad Samedov, the discoverer of [[Neft Daşları|Oil Rocks]].<ref name=":4" />

Samadova was repeatedly elected a member of academic councils and specialized scientific commissions, both in Azerbaijan and outside the country. She was a member of the editorial board of two scientific journals.<ref name=":0" /> Under her leadership, 4 doctors of science and 20 doctors of philosophy were trained.<ref name=":2" />

Samadova died on 8 January 2020 in Baku at the age of 91.<ref name=":0" />

== Awards ==
In 2004 Samadova received the [[Shohrat Order]].<ref name=":3" />

In 2012, Samadova was awarded the title of Honorary Scientist of Europe and [[Alexander von Humboldt Medal (EGU)|Alexander von Humboldt Medal]].<ref name=":3" />
